body: I'll defer to @comius for long term plans, but there is nobody assigned to work on this right now.
@c-mita or @oquenchil might be more familiar with coverage
@c-mita @oquenchil any plans to fix this soon?

I've done a bit of an investigation, but I won't pretend to understand what's going on in `JacocoCoverageRunner` at this time.
I've cobbled together an experiment (at https://github.com/c-mita/bazel/tree/jacoco_classpath) that seems to work for my small test cases, but I don't know enough to say if it's "correct".

issue.title: Allow Jacoco Coverage to work with classpath jar.

repository.name: bazel
repository.description: a fast, scalable, multi-language and extensible build system

issue.body:
If the classpath for a java binary exceeds the limits specified, a
separate jar is created at runtime to contain the classpath and is the
target of execution. The JacocoRunner could not handle this case, only
inspecting the wrapping jar.

This change adds code to extract the objects in the original classpath
and pass them to the original handling code.

Fixes #11847
